name: A Double Sided Mirror
source:
We all deserve to be happy.

You got out of a bad relationship, and the only thing you need now is peace of mind.

Since you don't have any family or friends close to where you live, the only way you've found to meet new people is through a dating app.

As the days go by, you meet a guy through that app. After some thought, you decide to set up a date to meet your new friend, so that you can ignore your past problems and focus on your future, but...

Is this really the solution to your problems? Or is it maybe the worst decision you've ever made?

Well, maybe it's just an exaggeration, after all, as you always say, we all deserve to be happy... Right?

[From [url=https://glassberrystudios.itch.io/adoublesidedmirror]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我们都值得幸福。

你已经摆脱了一段糟糕的关系，现在你唯一需要的就是内心的平静。

由于你在居住地附近没有家人或朋友，因此结识新朋友的唯一方法就是通过约会应用程序。

随着日子一天天过去，你通过那个应用程序认识了一个人。经过深思熟虑，你决定约个时间去见见你的新朋友，这样你就可以忽略过去的问题，专注于未来，但是……

这真的能解决你的问题吗？或者这可能是你做过的最糟糕的决定？

好吧，也许这只是一种夸张，毕竟，正如你常说的，我们都应该幸福……对吧？
